integrity: The proof combines the published CC-ring clique decomposition with unique cyclotomic factorization and Möbius inversion. Exhaustive finite profile checks and direct upper-triangular matrix-ring examples are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The completeness statement is restricted to commuting graphs of finite CC-rings.
For a general finite CC-ring the polynomial recovers centralizer sizes only after subtracting the center size, not the ring isomorphism type.
Domination-equivalent nonisomorphic graphs exist outside the CC-ring commuting-graph class.
title: The domination polynomial is complete on finite CC-ring commuting graphs
